target_customer: People with OCD (consumers), and earlier primary care practices that referred patients to therapists
problem: OCD is often hidden and takes years to diagnose, and ERP therapy is costly and hard to access. The first version also tackled the gap between primary care and therapists.
business_model: Started as a referral and billing service for primary care practices with insurer claims; later a consumer AI guide for OCD (pricing not found)
product_category: Digital mental health, AI therapy guide

founders.name: Jamison Mercurio
founders.background_notes: Former Meta iOS and web engineer (Messenger Video Chat, Facebook News) per YC page.

founders.name: Zachary Gittelman
education: University of Michigan and Cornell, CS
founders.background_notes: Healthcare startup experience including scheduling automation and a medical supplies marketplace.

competitors.name: NOCD
competitors.what: Virtual specialty clinic delivering ERP therapy for OCD with licensed therapists and an app
competitors.traction_then: 12,000 telehealth visits per month in Sept 2021
competitors.funding_then: $33M Series B in Sept 2021 led by F-Prime, after a $12M Series A

technical_complexity.rationale: A referral and scheduling service with claims submission is standard software plus healthcare operations. The later LLM guide for ERP sessions added clinical safety design but used off the shelf models.

defensibility.rationale: Referral workflows and an LLM wrapper for OCD guidance were easy to copy, and an established funded player (NOCD) already owned the OCD niche.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No public record of an incumbent copying or buying it; the company shows as Inactive on YC.

market_need_then: YC page cites research that OCD takes about 12 years to diagnose and affects nearly 2 percent of people. NOCD's 2021 raise shows paying demand for OCD care at the time.

branding.domain_note: Used themangohealth.com rather than an exact match; other firms hold similar Mango Health names and trademarks.

identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly and light, closing its YC blurb with a smiley and a call to start today

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand; name is shared with several unrelated Mango Health entities.

pivots.from: Primary care to therapist referral and billing service (launched March 2024)
pivots.to: AI guide for OCD with ERP like sessions
pivots.why: Not stated in sources found; exact date of the switch is not documented

outcome_analysis: Mango Health began as a primary care referral service in early 2024, then repositioned as an AI guide for OCD. YC now lists it as Inactive with a team of two, but no source states a shutdown date or cause, so the cause is not public. The only failure code supported by the record is a pivot that did not visibly find traction; funding history is unknown rather than zero.
notes: The company website field is empty in the directory (themangohealth.com was named on the YC blurb) and was not fetched. One aggregator lists a $0.5M convertible note on 2024-01 with YC as investor; unverified single source, so not recorded as a round. CB Insights and Seedtable entries for Mango Health describe different companies. Exit type is shutdown inferred from YC Inactive status only.
